原: That means concentrating on the direction of your life in general, and your own. Academic performance specifically, for example.
疑为: That means concentrating on the direction of your life in general, and your own academic performance specifically, for example.
理由: your own 与 academic performance 是一个名词短语，被句号从中间切成第 63、64 两句；按一句的意思译，分在两句里。
